queer_characters.name: Ellie Chu
queer_characters.notes: Source states the narrative centers on her journey toward self-acceptance regarding her lesbian identity; critics praised the portrayal of a young lesbian immigrant's self-acceptance.

queer_characters.name: Aster Flores
queer_characters.notes: Source states Aster acknowledges her own feelings for Ellie and rejects her boyfriend's proposal, but no specific label is given in the text, so the umbrella 'queer' tag is used.
